v2 S1 terrain-rect: landscape map sheets that fill every map view

BIC-49 preset (v2, Scenario.version = 2)
- The issued sketch is kept untouched in the centre of a 13.5 x 9.5 km
  landscape sheet (eastings 03-30, northings 64-83; grid labels of the
  sketch area unchanged 12-21). Authored in the sketch frame and moved into
  the map frame with the new translateScenario helper (+4500 m E).
- Plausible flank terrain joins the sketch at the seams: border/BOP line
  (BOPs 59/60, 63/64; Foxland 79/80, 83/84), Dry Nullah, Disty No 5,
  lateral and NW tracks and the Chak 18 rd continued edge to edge; new
  W road (Cl 30) and E road (Cl 9) with computed bridges (Br 4-8), Kot
  Bahadur Minor, villages with Punjabi names (Hayatabad of "incl
  Hayatabad" now on the sheet), rises, kidney bunds, clumps, broken gr.
- Bn rt bdry (139 | 146) frames B Coy on the E flank.
- TerrainData.noise keeps the v1 micro-relief frame, so the sketch area is
  bit-identical to v1 (LOS/going/cover) and the wargame balance holds.

Versioning and migration
- src/scenario/transform.ts: translate scenario/DS/features/plan/AAR.
- src/scenario/migrate.ts + ui/data.ts ensureSeed: attempts made on an
  older preset frame are translated (plan units pos/altPos/area, graphics,
  group outlines, replay frames, en plan) and stamped scenarioVersion;
  idempotent. The stored preset is replaced when its version differs; new
  attempts are stamped. Unused v1 portrait sample scenarios are
  regenerated. Import never downgrades a preset and re-runs the migration.

Generator
- Every level is a landscape sheet (aspect 1.5 / 1.42) with the AOR in
  the centre; roads spread across the width (one through the AOR), water
  lines, border and scattered features scaled to fill the extent; spare
  rises are left unnamed instead of being dropped. DS analysis unchanged.

Map views
- MapRenderer.clampView: framed views never zoom out beyond the sheet or
  pan past its edges, so briefing/planner/wargame/scenario views and the
  Fit button always fill their panel (overlays with layers.terrain=false
  or bounded=false are left alone for the 3D drape). Water labels follow
  the visible stretch; country names stay in view. Thumbnails show the
  AOR with its flanks.

Performance
- stampLine rasterises per segment (bit-identical output): BIC-49 terrain
  build 360 ms -> ~30-90 ms in Node for 540 x 380 cells. A* keeps full
  resolution up to 240k cells (paths identical to v1).
- terrainFor cache keyed by extent too (a re-framed preset, or generated
  scenarios sharing a seed, no longer reuse a stale raster).

Tests: landscape preset, landmarks/DS positions, seams, names, translate
round trip, v1 attempt migration, generator aspect/fill, view clamping.

Make WarGamer an app: Electron desktop app, installable PWA, release CI

Desktop app (electron/):
- main.cjs serves dist/WarGamer.html over a private app://wargamer origin so
  IndexedDB lives in the app's userData and survives updates; secure defaults
  (contextIsolation, sandbox, no node integration, remote navigation blocked,
  external links open in the default browser, device permissions denied),
  single-instance lock, remembered window size/position, min size 1100x700.
- Menus: File (open data folder, quit), View (reload, zoom, F11 full screen),
  Classroom (host classroom on LAN / show addresses / stop hosting), Help
  (user guide rendered from README.md, about with versions + data folder).
- Classroom hosting runs the LAN server in-process (data in
  userData/classroom), copies local records the classroom db does not have,
  switches the window to the shared db and shows the student address.
- preload.cjs exposes a minimal window.wargamerDesktop API.
- WebGL falls back to SwiftShader on blocklisted / VM GPUs (3D view).

LAN server: refactored into server/lan-core.cjs (shared by the CLI and the
desktop app); server/lan-server.mjs keeps its CLI. Adds PWA files with
correct MIME types, port retries, corrupt-db recovery, flush on exit.

PWA: build.mjs emits manifest.webmanifest, sw.js (cache-first app shell,
cache keyed by app version + page hash, /api and other origins never
intercepted) and icons. src/pwa.ts registers it only on http(s) outside the
desktop app. Data & settings gains an "App & version" card (version, run
mode, Install as app, desktop classroom hosting).

Packaging: electron-builder config (win nsis + portable, mac dmg + zip
x64/arm64 ad-hoc signed, linux AppImage + deb), npm run app / dist:*.
Icon: build/icon.svg rendered to PNGs. CI: .github/workflows/release.yml
builds on all three OSes and publishes a GitHub Release on v* tags.
README: "Install & run" section. Tests: tests/app.test.ts.

Add WarGamer: offline tactical wargaming trainer

Single-file offline app (dist/WarGamer.html) for training young officers
in minor and major ops, built on ICIB "The Rifle Company, Platoon and
Section in Battle" as the doctrinal reference.

- Exercise flow: briefing, appreciation, plan marking with NATO APP-6
  symbols and tactical graphics, pre-planned contingencies, submit,
  wargame, debrief with replay and casualty analysis
- Simulation: Foxland enemy AI (recce, adv guard, probe, FAA/FUP/H hr,
  BOF, tanks, breaching, Ph 2, second wave), fog of war, arty/mor DF and
  SOS, QC and A/QC, UCAV on justified demand, obstacles, close combat,
  local and higher C attk, C pen, reorg
- Objective marking: plan rubric (9 groups, level norms), doctrinal
  decision evaluator, battle outcome and conduct, final grade
- Scenarios: TE Def BIC-49 preset with DS solution; random generator for
  Pl/Coy/Bn/Bde on four terrain types with automatic terrain analysis
- Instructor and student dashboards: classes, students, scenarios,
  exercises, results heatmap, CSV, review/adjust, backups and packs
- IndexedDB storage, optional zero-dependency LAN server
- Unit tests for terrain, generator, marking, decisions and simulation
